senses.gloss:
प्रभज् प्र-भज्, cl. 1. P. A. -भजति, -ते,
-भक्तुम्, to execute, accomplish; to honour; to
divide.

प्र-भाज्, क्, क्, क्, dividing, sharing, one who
divides or shares.

प्र-भाग, अस्, m. division; (in arithmetic) the
fraction of a fraction, a sub-fraction.
—प्रभाग-
जाति, इस्, f. reducing the fraction of a fraction to a
simple fraction, reduction of sub-fractions to a com-
mon denominator.
प्रभाग प्र-भाग. See प्र-भज्, p. 634.

प्रभञ्ज् प्र-भञ्ज् [cf. प्र-भज्], cl. 7. P.
-भनक्ति, -भङ्क्तुम्, to break to pieces, break
down, break up, break, destroy; to defeat, conquer.

प्र-भग्न, अस्, आ, अम्, broken to pieces, broken
down, broken up, broken, destroyed.

प्र-भङ्गिन्, ई, इनी, इ, Ved. breaking, crushing,
destroying.

प्र-भङ्गुर, अस्, आ, अम्, destroying; perishable,
transitory (?).

प्र-भज्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being broken to
pieces, being broken up.

प्र-भञ्जन, अस्, ई, अम्, breaking down, break-
ing, destroying; (अस्), m. air, wind, storm, tempest,
hurricane; the god of the winds; a nervous disease;
N. of a prince; (अम्), n. breaking to pieces.

प्राभञ्जन प्राभञ्जन, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्र-
भञ्जन), presided over by the god of wind; (अम्),
n., scil. नक्षत्र or भ, the Nakṣatra Svāti.

प्रभद्र प्र-भद्र, अस्, m. the plant Azadi-
rachta Indica; (आ), f. a kind of plant (= प्रसारिणी).

प्रभद्रक, अस्, आ, अम्, exceedingly handsome
or beautiful; (अम्), n. a kind of metre, four times
˘˘˘˘¯˘¯˘˘˘¯˘¯˘¯.

प्रभर्तव्य प्र-भर्तव्य, &c. See under
प्र-भृ, p. 636, col. 1.

प्र-भर्तव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be supported or
nourished.
प्रभव प्र-भव, &c. See under प्र-भू.

प्र-भव, अस्, m. production, birth; origin,
source, cause of existence; generative cause, the basis
or root of being or existence; the operative cause or
immediate origin of being, as the father or mother,
&c.; the place of receiving existence or that where
an object is first perceived, birthplace; the source
of a river [cf. यमुना-प्˚]; the Creator; strength,
might, superiority, power, majesty (= प्र-भाव);
N. of a Sādhya; N. of the first or thirty-fifth year
[]
in a sixty years’ cycle of Jupiter; (अस्, आ, अम्), be-
coming prominent, prominent, excelling, excellent,
eminent, distinguished; superior, powerful; (at the
end of a comp.) springing or originating from,
rising from, derived from, belonging to; born, pro-
duced.
—प्रभव-प्रभु, उस्, m. (with Jainas)
N. of one of the six Śruta-kevalins.
प्रभाव प्र-भाव, &c. See col. 3.

प्र-भाव, अस्, m. might, power, puissance,
strength, efficacy, virtue; majesty, dignity, glory,
grandeur; superhuman strength or power; effect;
extension, circumference; splendor, brilliance; high
spirit, spirit, magnanimity; tranquillizing, concilia-
tion (?); N. of a chapter of the Rasika-priyā; N.
of a son of Manu Sva-rocis; प्रभावेण, प्रभा-
वात्, प्रभाव-तस्, by or through the power of, by
means of, in consequence of, through, by.
—प्रभा-
व-ज, अस्, आ, अम्, proceeding from conscious majesty
or power.
—प्रभाव-ता, f. power, dignity, su-
periority.
—प्रभाव-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, possessing
power or strength, powerful, strong, mighty.

प्राभव प्राभव, अम्, n. (fr. प्र-भु), pre-
eminence, superiority, supremacy.

प्रभा 1. प्र-भा, cl. 2. P. -भाति, -भातुम्,
to shine forth, shine, gleam; to begin to become
light, begin to dawn; to appear, seem; to illuminate,
enlighten.

2. प्र-भा, f. light, splendor, radiance, effulgence
[cf. अचिर-प्˚, धूम-प्˚]; a ray of light; the shadow
of the gnomon on a sun-dial; Light variously per-
sonified (as wife of the Sun; or as wife of Kalpa
and mother of Prātar, Madhyan-dina, and Sāya,
i. e. of Morning, Midday, and Evening; or as a
daughter of Svar-bhānu and mother of Nahuṣa);
a N. of Durgā; of an Apsaras; of a herdsman's
wife; of the city of Kuvera; a kind of metre, four
times ˘˘˘˘˘˘¯,˘¯¯˘¯; N. of a commentary
by Vaidya-nātha on the Kāvya-pradīpa; of a com-
mentary on the Śabda-kaustubha.
—प्रभा-कर,
अस्, ई, अम्, causing light or splendor, radiant, luminous;
(अस्), m. ‘light-maker,’ the sun; the moon; fire;
the ocean; a N. of a Śiva; N. of a deity under the
eighth Manu; of a sage of the race of Atri; of a
teacher of the Mīmāṃsā philosophy associated with
Kumārila-bhaṭṭa; of the author of the Rasa-pradīpa
and of the Laghu-sapta-śatikā-stava; N. of a Samādhi;
[]
(ई), f. (with Buddhists) N. of one of the ten Bhūmis;
(अम्), n., N. of a Varṣa.
—प्रभाकर-देव, अस्,
m., N. of a minister in Kaśmīra; of a poet.
—प्र-
भाकर-वर्धन, अस्, m., N. of a king.
—प्र-
भाकर-वर्मन्, आ, m., N. of a minister in Kaś-
mīra.
—प्रभाकरवर्म-स्वामिन्, ई, m. ‘lord of
Prabhākara-varman,’ the statue of the tutelary deity
of Prabhākara-varman.
—प्रभाकर-सिद्धि, इस्,
m., N. of a learned man.
—प्रभाकर-स्वामिन्, ई,
m., N. of a temple of Viṣṇu built by Prabhākara-
varman.
—प्रभा-कीट, अस्, m. ‘light-insect,’ a fire-
fly.
—प्रभाञ्जन (˚भा-अञ्˚), अस्, m. the tree
Hyperanthera Moringa; [cf. शोभाञ्जन.]
—प्र-
भा-तरल, अस्, आ, अम्, tremulously radiant; प्र-
भातरलं ज्योतिः, a tremulously radiant flash,
i. e. a flash of lightning.
—प्रभा-तीर्थ, अम्, n.,
N. of a Tīrtha.
—प्रभा-पल्लवित, अस्, आ, अम्,
having natural radiance in place of red dye.
—प्र-
भा-पाल, अस्, m., N. of a Bodhi-sattva.
—प्रभा-
प्ररोह, अस्, m. ‘a shoot of light,’ a flash or ray
of light.
—प्रभा-मण्डल, अम्, n. a circle or
crown of rays.
—प्रभामण्डल-शोभिन्, ई, इनी, इ,
shining with a circle of rays.
—प्रभा-मय, अस्,
ई, अम्, consisting of light, shining.
—प्रभा-लेपिन्,
ई, इनी, इ, covered with splendor.
—प्रभा-वत्, आन्,
अती, अत्, having light, luminous, radiant, splendid,
resplendent; (अती), f., N. of a goddess; of the wife
of the Sun; of one of the Mātṛs attending on
Skanda; of an Apsaras; of a sister of the Asura
Indra-damana; of a daughter of king Vajra-nābha
and wife of Pra-dyumna; of the wife of Citra-ratha
king of Aṅga; of a daughter of Su-vīra and wife of
Marutta; of a Tāpasī; of the mother of Malli the
nineteenth Arhat of the present Ava-sarpiṇī; N. of
the daughter of the Śreṣṭhin Soma-datta and wife of
Madana the son of Vikrama-sena; of the lute of one
of the Gaṇas or demigods attendant on Śiva; N. of a
drama; of a metre, four times ¯¯˘¯˘˘˘˘¯˘¯˘¯;
of another metre, four times ¯¯˘¯˘˘¯˘¯˘¯˘¯.
—प्रभावती-परिणय, अस्, m. ‘the marriage of
Prabhāvatī,’ N. of a drama by Viśva-nātha (= प्र-
भा-वती).
—प्रभा-व्यूह, अस्, m., N. of a god;
(also read प्रभ-व्यूह.)
—प्रभेश्वर-तीर्थ
(˚भा-ईश्˚), अम्, n., N. of a place of pilgrimage.

प्र-भात, अस्, आ, अम्, shone forth; begun to
become clear or light; (अम्), n. morning, dawn,
day-break; (अस्), m., N. of a Vasu (in this sense
incorrectly for प्र-भास).
प्र-भान, अम्, n. light, radiance, shining.

प्र-भानीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be irradiated or
lighted.
प्र-भापन, अम्, n. causing to shine.
प्र-भापनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be caused to shine,
प्रभारक प्रभारक, अस्, m., N. of a Nāga.

प्रभाष् प्र-भाष्, cl. 1. A. -भाषते, -भा-
षितुम्, to speak to, address, converse with; to de-
clare, proclaim, publish, announce; to divulge, dis-
close, reveal, manifest; to expound, explain; to
prate, prattle: Pass. -भाष्यते, to be called or
named.

प्रभास् प्र-भास्, cl. 1. A. (ep. also P.)
-भासते (-ति), -भासितुम्, to shine, be brilliant;
to appear: Caus. -भासयति, -यितुम्, to irradiate,
illuminate, enlighten.

प्र-भाष, अस्, m., N. of a Vasu; (a wrong
reading for प्र-भास.)

प्र-भास, अस्, m. splendor, beauty; N. of a
Vasu; of a being attendant on Skanda; of a deity
under the eighth Manu; (with Jainas) N. of one of
the eleven Gaṇādhipas; of a minister of Candra-
pāla king of Madra; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a race of
[]
Ṛṣis; (अस्, अम्), m. n., N. of a celebrated place
of pilgrimage on the west coast of the Dekhan near
Dvārakā.
प्र-भाषण, अम्, n. explanation, interpretation.

प्रभाषणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, relating to explanation
or interpretation.
प्र-भाषित, अस्, आ, अम्, spoken, uttered.
प्र-भाषिन्, ई, इणी, इ, saying, speaking.

प्र-भासत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, shining forth, shining,
effulgent.
प्र-भासन, अम्, n. irradiating, illumining.

प्र-भास्वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, shining forth, shining
brightly, brilliant.
प्र-भास्वर, अस्, आ, अम्, = प्र-भास्वत्.

प्रभिद् 1. प्र-भिद्, cl. 7. P. -भिनत्ति,
-भेत्तुम्, to split asunder, split, cleave; to pierce,
bore, break open, open: Pass. -भिद्यते, to be
broken to pieces, crumble (intrans.); to bud forth,
open, expand (as a flower); to split, divide (intrans.).

2. प्र-भिद्, त्, त्, त्, splitting or tearing asunder,
splitting, cleaving.

प्र-भिन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, split asunder, split, cleft,
divided, severed; broken to pieces, broken through;
well cut, cut off, detached; pierced, bored, opened;
budding, expanded; loosened, relaxed; disfigured,
deformed, altered, changed; different, distinct;
(अस्), m. a furious elephant, an elephant in rut or
from whose temples a fragrant fluid exudes; [cf. 2.
दान, p. 408, col. 1.]
—प्रभिन्न-करट, अस्, आ,
अम्, ‘cloven-cheeked,’ having the cheeks cleft (during
the exuding of a fragrant fluid, as an elephant in
the rutting season).
—प्रभिन्न-विष्, ट्, ट्, ट्,
having the feces divided or relaxed.
—प्रभिन्नाञ्-
जन (˚न-अञ्˚), अम्, n. ‘mixed collyrium,’ an
eye-salve mixed with oil (= भिन्नाञ्जन).
प्रभेद प्र-भेद. See 1. प्र-भिद्, p. 635.

प्र-भेदक, अस्, इका, अम्, tearing asunder, cleav-
ing, separating, severing; piercing; distinguishing.
प्र-भेदन, अस्, ई, अम्, = प्र-भेदक.

प्रभी प्र-भी, cl. 3. P. -बिभेति, -भेतुम्,
to be greatly afraid of, to be terrified at (with abl.).
प्र-भीत, अस्, आ, अम्, terrified, afraid.
प्रभु प्र-भु, &c. See col. 3.

प्र-भु, उस्, उस्, or वी, उ, or Ved. प्र-भू, ऊस्, वी,
उ, excelling, surpassing; powerful (e. g. रुद्राद् अपि
प्रभुः, more powerful even than Rudra), mighty,
strong; able, capable, competent, having power to
(e. g. प्रहर्तुम् प्रभुः, having power to wound);
more than sufficient, abundant; a match for (e. g.
प्रभुर् मल्लाय, a match for a wrestler); con-
stant, eternal, everlasting; (उस्), m. a superior, ruler,
governor, master, lord, (किम्-प्रभु, a bad master); an
owner, proprietor; an epithet of Brahma; of Viṣṇu;
of Śiva; of Indra; N. of a deity under the eighth
Manu; N. of a son of Kardama; of a son of Śuka
and Pīvarī; of a son of Bhaga and Siddhi; a sound;
quicksilver.
—प्रभु-ता, f. or प्रभु-त्व, अम्, n.
lordship, supremacy, sovereignty, ascendancy, great-
ness, power; ownership, proprietorship, possession.
—प्रभुत्वाक्षेप (˚त्व-आक्˚), अस्, m. (in rhe-
toric) an allusion to the superiority or supremacy (of
another).
—प्रभु-देव, अस्, m., N. of a teacher
of the Yoga system of philosophy.
—प्रभु-भक्त,
अस्, आ, अम्, attached or devoted to a lord, faithful to
a master, loyal; (अस्), m. a good horse.
—प्रभु-
भक्ति, इस्, f. attachment to a lord or master, loyalty,
faithfulness.
—प्रभू-त्व, अम्, n., Ved. the being
sufficient, sufficiency; [cf. प्रभु-त्व.]
—प्रभू-
वसु, उस्, उस्, उ (in the Pada-pāṭha written प्रभु-
वसु), Ved. ‘abundantly wealthy,’ an epithet of Indra;
(उस्), m., N. of a descendant of Aṅgiras and author
of the hymns Ṛg-veda V. 35, 36, IX. 35, 36.

प्रभू प्र-भू, cl. 1. P. (rarely also A.)
-भवति (-ते), -भवितुम्, to come into being,
come forth, spring forth, spring up; to proceed, rise,
arise, originate; to be brought forth; to become;
to become manifest, appear; to extend beyond, sur-
pass (Ved.); to become more numerous, become
numerous, multiply, increase, become prevalent; to
be strong or powerful, prevail; to prevail over, have
power or control over (with gen., loc., or dat.); to
be a match for (with dat.); to be able or equal
to (with inf.); to have power for, be competent to
(with dat. or loc.); to be useful, be of use; to profit,
avail; to beseech, intreat, implore: Caus. -भाव-
यति, -यितुम्, to cause to come forth; to increase,
augment, multiply (e. g. to multiply the Soma by
placing it in a greater number of vessels); to provide
more amply, endow more richly; to make powerful,
cause to thrive or prosper, nurture; to gain power
or strength; to recognise, discern: Desid. of Caus.
-बिभावयिषति, to wish to increase, wish to
lengthen or prolong (Ved.).

प्रभुज् 1. प्र-भुज् (see rt. 1. भुज्), cl. 6. P.
-भुजति, -भोक्तुम्, to bend forwards, incline, bend.
प्र-भुग्न, see Scholiast on Pāṇ. VIII. 4, 29.

प्र-भवत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, coming forth, arising;
exceeding; being powerful, prevailing.

प्रभवति-तराम्, ind. has greater efficacy, has
more power, has great power.

प्रभावन, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. the Nom. below),
mighty, having power over, ruling, governing.

प्र-भावन; add — (fr. the Caus.), causing to
come forth, creating; causing to prosper.

प्र-भावना, f. causing to come forth, disclosing,
revealing, uttering.

प्र-भवनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, see Scholiast on Pāṇ.
VIII. 4, 34.

प्र-भवितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, powerful, potent; (ता),
m. a lord, ruler.

प्र-भविष्णु, उस्, उस्, उ, pre-eminent; mighty,
strong, powerful, potent; (उस्), m. a mighty man,
lord, master, lord over (with loc. or gen.).
—प्र-
भविष्णु-ता, f. lordship, supremacy, dominion,
power, might, authority, consequence.

प्र-भावक, अस्, आ, अम्, prominent, having
power or influence, influential.

प्रभावय, Nom. P. प्रभावयति, -यितुम्,
to have power, exercise power, to have great influ-
ence or power over (with acc.).

प्र-भावयितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, making powerful or
mighty (with acc.); enduing with power, empowering.

प्र-भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, produced, sprung from;
[]
become, been; increased, much, abundant; abound-
ing in; existing in great numbers, numerous, many;
gone up or upwards; high, lofty; long; governed,
presided over; mature, perfect.
—प्रभूत-तम,
अस्, आ, अम्, very great or numerous, greatest, highest.
—प्रभूत-तर, अस्, आ, अम्, greater, more nu-
merous, very large.
—प्रभूत-ता, f. or प्रभूत-
त्व, अम्, n. abundance, plenty; multitude, great
number.
—प्रभूत-नागाश्व-रथ, अस्, आ, अम्,
having many elephants and horses and chariots.
—प्रभूत-यवसेन्धन (˚स-इन्˚), अस्, आ, अम्,
abounding in fresh grass and fuel.
—प्रभूत-
रत्न, अस्, m., N. of a Buddha.
—प्रभूत-रूप,
अम्, n. great beauty.
—प्रभूत-वयस्, आस्, आस्,
अस्, advanced in age, old.
—प्रभूत-वर्ष, आणि,
n. pl. many years.

प्रभूतक, अस्, आ, अम्, containing the word
प्रभूत (as an Adhyāya or an Anuvāka); epithet
of a class of Manes.

प्र-भूति, इस्, f. source, origin; power; imperious
demeanour; sufficiency.

प्र-भूवन्, आ, अरी, अ, Ved. reaching or ex-
tending beyond (with acc.).

प्र-भूष्णु, उस्, उस्, उ, powerful, mighty, strong,
able; [cf. प्र-भविष्णु.]

प्रभृ प्र-भृ, cl. 1. 3. P. A. -भरति, -ते,
-बिभर्ति, -बिभृते, -भर्तुम्, Ved. to bring or
carry towards, bring before, to lead or bring for-
wards, place before; to offer, present; to stretch forth,
extend; to hurl, cast; to bring in, introduce.

प्र-भरत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, bringing or leading
towards, bringing nigh.

प्र-भर्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ, Ved. one who brings
or leads near to, bringing near, (Sāy. = सम्यक्
प्रभरन्.)

प्र-भर्मन्, अ, n., Ved. bringing towards, placing
before; reciting, recitation.

प्र-भृति, इस्, f. offering, oblation (Ved.); throw-
ing, casting, hurling (Ved.); beginning, commence-
ment, (in this latter sense often used in three genders
at the end of comps. to express ‘having as a begin-
ning or commencement,’ ‘commencing with,’ or =
‘et cætera,’ e. g. मुनयः सोमश्रवः-प्रभृ-
तयः, the Munis beginning with Soma-śravas, i. e. the
Munis, Soma-śravas, &c.; वर्णा ब्राह्मण-प्र-
भृतयः, the Brāhmans and other castes); प्र-
भृति, ind. beginning with, commencing with, be-
ginning with and continuing from, from — forward,
from — upward, from, since (at the end of comps.,
e. g. तत्-प्रभृति, from that time forward; जन्म-
प्रभृति, from birth; or after a word in the abl.,
e. g. बाल्यात् प्रभृति, from boyhood upwards;
स्कन्धात् प्रभृति, from the shoulder; or after
adverbs, e. g. अद्य प्रभृति, beginning from to-day,
from this time forwards, henceforward, henceforth;
अधः प्रभृति, from below, downwards; ततः
प्रभृति or तदा प्रभृति, from that time for-
wards, thenceforth).
प्र-भृथ, अस्, m., Ved. an offering, oblation.

प्रभ्रंश् प्र-भ्रंश्, cl. 4. P., 1. A. -भ्रश्-
यति, -भ्रंशते, -भ्रंशितुम्, to fall off, drop
off, slip off, fall down, fall away; to escape from,
free one's self from (with abl.); to be deprived of
(with inst.): Caus. -भ्रंशयति, -यितुम्, to cause
to fall down, cast down; to cause to fall from, cause
to lose (with abl.).
प्र-भ्रंश, अस्, m. falling off, becoming separated.

प्र-भ्रंशथु, उस्, m. a disease of the nose
accompanied with discharge of mucus.

प्र-भ्रंशित, अस्, आ, अम्, caused to fall down,
cast down; caused to fall from, deprived of (with
abl.); expelled.
प्र-भ्रंशिन्, ई, इनी, इ, falling off, falling down.

प्र-भ्रंशुक, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. falling off;
vanishing, disappearing.

प्र-भ्रश्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, falling down,
being broken off, being broken down.

प्र-भ्रष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, fallen off, fallen, drop-
ping; broken.

प्र-भ्रष्टक, अम्, n. a chaplet or wreath of
flowers suspended from the lock on the crown of
the head.

प्रभ्राज् प्र-भ्राज्, cl. 1. A. -भ्राजते, -भ्रा-
जितुम्, Ved. to shine forth, gleam.

प्र-भ्राजमान, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. shining forth,
gleaming.

प्राभवत्य, अम्, n. (fr. प्र-भवत्), superi-
ority, power, authority, ascendancy.

प्राभूतिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्र-भूत), see
Vārttika II. to Pāṇ. IV. 4, 1.

प्राभाकर प्राभाकर, अस्, m. (fr. प्रभा-
कर), a follower of Prabhā-kara, the designation
of a particular philosophical sect (a branch of the
Mīmāṃsā school).

प्राभातिक प्राभातिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्र-
भात), belonging or relating to the morning, matu-
tinal.

प्राभासिक प्राभासिक, अस्, ई, अम्, belonging
to the place Pra-bhāsa, q. v.

प्राभृत प्राभृत, अम्, n. (fr. प्र-भृति),
a present, gift, offering of ceremony; an offering to a
deity or sovereign; a bribe; a term applied to the
chapters of the Sūrya-prajñapti.
—प्राभृती-कृत,
अस्, आ, अम्, given as a present, offered.
प्राभृतक, अम्, n. a present, an offering.
